verification_policy.delivery_path: branch -> pull request -> CI checks -> reviewed merge
do_not_claim_done_without: documented residual risks for blocked gates
verification_policy.quality_ratchet: new hardening must be additive, rollbackable, and documented

environment.node: 20 in CI; local baseline observed on v18.19.1

advisory_gates.name: TypeScript no-emit check
advisory_gates.promotion_condition: passes on main without suppressing real data-shape issues
advisory_gates.current_status: failing on existing calendar and habit record shape errors

advisory_gates.name: Expo lint
advisory_gates.promotion_condition: ESLint dependencies and config are committed and npm-based
advisory_gates.current_status: blocked because Expo CLI tries to install ESLint through missing yarnpkg

advisory_gates.name: automated test suite
advisory_gates.promotion_condition: a real test script exists and covers critical user journeys

pre_merge: GitHub Actions CI / Web build and release bundle passes
PR includes evidence for any skipped advisory gate
rollback note is present for release-impacting changes
pre_deploy: release bundle artifact is created from CI
required EXPO_PUBLIC_* environment variables are present in the target runtime
target runtime can serve the artifact
rollback target points to previous successful release
post_deploy: GET /health when the target runtime exposes it
manual or automated smoke covers sign-in entry, task view, habit creation path, calendar view, and leaderboard view where credentials permit

known_blockers: No blocking automated regression test suite exists.
TypeScript check fails on pre-existing CalendarEvent and Habit data-shape casts.
Lint is not deterministic because ESLint dependencies/config are not committed.
Shadow smoke cannot validate authenticated Firebase and Google Calendar journeys without credentials.
Service restart validation is not applicable until a concrete target service and restart command are documented.
